sentences.cn_text: 根据最高法院周四作出的一项裁决，各州将能够强制更多人在网购时缴纳销售税，这将使购物者的钱包缩水，但对各州而言却是一次重大的财政胜利。
sentences.en_text: States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states.

sentences.cn_text: 最高法院周四的意见推翻了两项已有数十年历史的裁决，各州称这些裁决每年令其损失数十亿美元的税收收入。
sentences.en_text: The Supreme Court’s opinion Thursday overruled a pair of decades-old decisions that states said cost them billions of dollars in lost revenue annually.

sentences.cn_text: 这些裁决使各州更难就某些网络购物行为征收销售税。
sentences.en_text: The decisions made it more difficult for states to collect sales tax on certain online purchases.

sentences.cn_text: 法院推翻的案件规定，如果企业将客户购买的商品运往该企业在当地没有实体机构（如仓库或办公室）的州，该企业就无需为该州代收销售税。
sentences.en_text: The cases the court overturned said that if a business was shipping a customer’s purchase to a state where the business didn’t have a physical presence such as a warehouse or office, the business didn’t have to collect sales tax for the state.

sentences.cn_text: 如果客户未被收取销售税，通常需要自行向州政府缴纳，但大多数人并未意识到自己负有此义务，实际缴纳者寥寥无几。
sentences.en_text: Customers were generally responsible for paying the sales tax to the state themselves if they weren’t charged it, but most didn’t realize they owed it and few paid.

sentences.cn_text: 大法官安东尼·肯尼迪写道，先前的裁决存在缺陷。
sentences.en_text: Justice Anthony Kennedy wrote that the previous decisions were flawed.

sentences.cn_text: 他在一份由另外四位大法官共同署名的意见书中写道：「实体存在规则每年都与经济现实越发脱节,并导致各州蒙受巨额税收损失。」
sentences.en_text: “Each year the physical presence rule becomes further removed from economic reality and results in significant revenue losses to the States,” he wrote in an opinion joined by four other justices.

sentences.cn_text: 肯尼迪写道，该规则「限制了各州谋求长期繁荣的能力，并妨碍了市场参与者在公平环境中竞争」。
sentences.en_text: Kennedy wrote that the rule “limited states’ ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field.”

sentences.cn_text: 这一裁决对在多个州设有机构的大型连锁企业来说是一次胜利，因为它们通常已经在网购环节征收销售税。
sentences.en_text: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already.

sentences.cn_text: 如今，竞争对手也将在此前未征税的地方开始征收销售税。
sentences.en_text: Now, rivals will be charging sales tax where they hadn’t before.

sentences.cn_text: 大型连锁企业一直在全国范围内征收销售税，因为它们通常在商品运往的州内拥有实体店。
sentences.en_text: Big chains have been collecting sales tax nationwide because they typically have physical stores in whatever state a purchase is being shipped to.

sentences.cn_text: 亚马逊公司凭借其遍布各地的仓库网络，也在每个征收销售税的州代收此税，但使用该平台的第三方卖家则无此义务。
sentences.en_text: Amazon.com, with its network of warehouses, also collects sales tax in every state that charges it, though third-party sellers who use the site don’t have to.

sentences.cn_text: 此前，许多仅在一个州或少数几个州设有实体机构的卖家，在向这些州以外的地址发货时能够规避征收销售税。
sentences.en_text: Until now, many sellers that have a physical presence in only a single state or a few states have been able to avoid charging sales taxes when they ship to addresses outside those states.

sentences.cn_text: 使用eBay和Etsy等为小型卖家提供平台的服务商的卖家，同样未在全国范围内征收销售税。
sentences.en_text: Sellers that use eBay and Etsy, which provide platforms for smaller sellers, also haven’t been collecting sales tax nationwide.

sentences.cn_text: 根据周四的裁决，各州可以通过法律要求州外卖家向客户征收该州的销售税并上缴州政府。
sentences.en_text: Under the ruling Thursday, states can pass laws requiring out-of-state sellers to collect the state’s sales tax from customers and send it to the state.

sentences.cn_text: 零售业贸易团体对该裁决表示赞赏，称其为本地企业与网络企业营造了公平的竞争环境。
sentences.en_text: Retail trade groups praised the ruling, saying it levels the playing field for local and online businesses.

sentences.cn_text: 零售分析师尼尔·桑德斯表示，输家是纯线上零售商，尤其是规模较小的那些。
sentences.en_text: The losers, said retail analyst Neil Saunders, are online-only retailers, especially smaller ones.

sentences.cn_text: 这些零售商可能会因遵守各州不同的销售税法而头疼不已。
sentences.en_text: Those retailers may face headaches complying with various state sales tax laws.

sentences.cn_text: 小企业与创业委员会倡导组织在一份声明中表示：「小企业和互联网创业者完全未能从这一裁决中获益。」
sentences.en_text: The Small Business & Entrepreneurship Council advocacy group said in a statement, “Small businesses and internet entrepreneurs are not well served at all by this decision.”

sentences.cn_text: 令更多网购者缴纳销售税

sentences.cn_text: 迫使某些州削减销售税

sentences.en_text: It can be learned from paragraphs 2 and 3 that the overruled decisions ______

sentences.cn_text: 描述了该裁决形成的漫长而复杂的过程
